scope: actual official/public HTTP retrieval through normal fenced worker; isolated local retained clone; no production readiness claim

health.collection_scope: Commercial Building and Electrical Permits: rolling 30-day issuance / 7-day status changes, plus literal data center/data centre and construction power/temporary service/t-pole initial backfill issued 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30, rechecked within the same counted query.
health.coverage_limitation: City limits only; literal-keyword backfill is not all data-center work. Older status changes outside the overlap or fixed backfill are not comprehensively monitored. Permit-listed names and permit-listed phones do not establish current employment or buying authority.

health.collection_scope: Up to four newest linked Com-ResNew monthly XLSX reports; only Commercial New Construction Permit rows. Repeated Record IDs retain the newest report snapshot while prior evidence versions remain stored.
health.coverage_limitation: As retrieved 2026-10-01, linked June-August 2026 workbooks contain 95 commercial rows / 89 unique Record IDs after six repeated IDs; issue dates span 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-28. Five use descriptions indicate residential occupancy despite the source Record Type being Commercial and are rejected by admission. Monthly publication lag leaves recent coverage incomplete. Does not cover all permits, alterations, or electrical permits, or prove current work, temporary-power need, load, rental demand, or authority.

health.collection_scope: NewCommercial FeatureServer/0 records issued in the previous 90 days; full layer count and exact window count reconciled across deterministic OBJECTID paging. Duplicate B1_ALT_ID rows collapse only when all semantic permit facts match.
health.coverage_limitation: As retrieved 2026-10-01 15:44Z, layer count 11,391; 90-day issue query returned 68 features / 67 unique permit IDs, dates 2026-08-04 through 2026-09-29; all 68 raw B1_APPL_ST values were blank. NewCommercial only, not citywide electrical coverage or all alterations. B1_APPL_ST is retained verbatim; one-character Status is geocoding status, not lifecycle. 60-day freshness bound. An issue event does not prove current work, rental need, load, fuel fit, or authority.

health.collection_scope: Permits filed in the last 90 days whose work description or project name names a data center, grouped per permit number across parcels.
health.coverage_limitation: City of Fort Worth permits only; neighboring cities and county permits are not covered. Projects that never use the words data center in the permit text are missed. Filed permits may be incomplete submittals; job value is the applicant's estimate.

health.collection_scope: Issued permits and submitted applications whose project name names a data center, submitted or issued in the last 90 days, grouped per permit number.
health.coverage_limitation: City of San Antonio permits only; unincorporated Bexar County and other cities are not covered. Projects whose permit name never says data center are missed. Valuation is the applicant's estimate.
Bounded rolling Taylor CivicPlus Development News/Notices categories 30/31 archive lookback with configured overlap; no atomic upstream snapshot is available.

health.collection_scope: All framed permit groups in current daf420.dat plus previous calendar month official end-of-month snapshot. One permit identity; lowest sequence is newest amendment. Older retained entities are never deleted by snapshot absence.
health.coverage_limitation: Not all historical Texas permits. No pending-application feed or older-month correction monitoring. Outages longer than the prior-month overlap can miss activity. Current file over four days old, missing previous-month EOM, changed framing, or bounds fail visibly. Production date, load, fuel suitability, rental demand and contacts are UNKNOWN.

health.collection_scope: Complete count-checked SWR 32 application result set for the prior three calendar days by submittal date, paged at 10 rows with a 50-page/500-record bound.
health.coverage_limitation: Applications for exceptions only, not flaring/venting measurements. Rule 32 also permits some flaring without an exception application. Public query excludes pre-2021-05-02 online-system filings; older filings outside the three-day submittal window are not rechecked for status changes and no historical backfill is included. Application details and authorization documents are not fetched. Physical flare/vent site, requested volume, gas composition, continuous flow, generator fit, MW, rental demand, buyer, and buying authority remain UNKNOWN.

health.collection_scope: All rows of the statewide pending NSR application listing; Plain Language Summary PDFs fetched only for data-center or power-generation filings, newest first, bounded per run.
health.coverage_limitation: Pending NSR case-by-case applications only; permits by rule and standard permits are not in this listing. TCEQ began moving pending-application publishing to its Permit Search Portal on August 31, 2026, so this listing may thin out. Summaries give site and purpose but rarely MW; proposed onsite generation is proposed supply, not adequate power.

health.collection_scope: Temporary concrete batch plant registrations on the statewide pending-permit summaries page; the Notice of Application and Preliminary Decision PDF is fetched for each, bounded per run.
health.coverage_limitation: Only applications still in TCEQ's public notice window. Registrations appear here briefly; earlier notices are not backfilled. The batch plant operator is a materials supplier, not the project owner or GC.
